reasons.dimension_theory_check.py:64 (box_dim_wi: PROPAGATED 2026-07-28 into cross_substrate/sturmian_hamiltonian_run.py alongside box_dim, which is retained BIT-IDENTICAL. A GENUINE un-propagated repair, and the saturation family again: box_dim selects `m = counts > 1`, which INCLUDES the fine-scale regime where every eigenvalue lands in its own box, so counts -> N and the log-log slope flattens toward a value set by the SAMPLING rather than by the set. box_dim_windowed fits only where counts >= 8 and <= 0.5N.
